title: Chicken and ginger congee
steps: Wash the rice and bring it to the boil with the stock and sliced ginger.
Simmer over low heat for 25–30 minutes, stirring often, until creamy.
Cut the chicken into thin strips and cook it in the congee for the last 6 minutes.
Boil the eggs for 7 minutes, peel and halve them.
Season the congee with soy sauce and sesame oil and serve with the eggs and spring onions.
